作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【Our patient was known diabetic and was in close contact with a COVID patient that’s why he presented to our dedicated clinics where PCR was done and the result came out positive and as the patient was clinically free he was sent for home quarantine and to follow up if any new manifestations appeared. 6 days later he presented to the ER with confusion, unsteadiness, memory impairment, disoriented to time and unsteady gait. On examination, the patient was vitally stable with no fever, or signs of meningeal irritation, ataxic gait, and left-sided hemiparesis grade 4, the patient was admitted for evaluation.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[293.75, 332.09, 332.19, 366.91], [116.72, 321.89, 192.51, 361.65], [254.79, 175.91, 333.81, 258.27], [297.0, 336.0, 340.0, 363.0], [292.0, 330.0, 328.0, 369.0], [133.0, 331.0, 186.0, 361.0], [108.0, 317.0, 196.0, 362.0], [260.0, 172.0, 326.0, 214.0], [252.0, 178.0, 338.0, 282.0]
【图像描述】：Axial FLAIR WIs (A, B, C and D) show areas of hyperintense signal involving mesial temporal lobes bilaterally, both middle cerebellar peduncles, splenium of corpus callosum, subcortical and periventricular WM of both cerebral hemispheres, DWIs (E, F and G) and ADC map (H and K) show diffusional restriction of middle cerebellar peduncles as well as the CC lesion while those scattered in the WM show no restriction. The post contrast images (L and M) show no contrast uptake in any of these images.
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Post-COVID-19 viral encephalopathy; Encephalitis; Ischaemic; Vasculitis; Demyelinating disease。结合特征，最终诊断为：Post-COVID-19 viral encephalopathy。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【A 45 year-old-patient with history of penetrating head trauma caused by a bull horn 1 year prior to evaluation, presented 3 episodes of epileptic seizures in the last 6 months. A non-enhanced head CT scan (not shown) reported an extra-axial frontal lesion suggesting meningioma; a brain MRI was ordered for further evaluation The patient was taken to surgery 3 months later where the lesion was excised. Histopathological evaluation found granulomatous necrosis with microorganisms that had yellow sulfur granules (Figure 2).】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[79.0, 42.0, 242.0, 207.0], [79.0, 42.0, 242.0, 207.0]
【图像描述】：Axial DWI weighted image of the brain shows no diffusion restriction
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Actinomyces osteomyelitis with subdural empyema; High grade meningioma; Pachymeningeal metastases; High grade oligodendroglioma。结合特征，最终诊断为：Actinomyces osteomyelitis with subdural empyema。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【An unconscious 30 year old female was presented to the emergency department. Toxicology screen was positive for insulin, benzodiazepines and ketamine. Glasgow coma scale remained low for several days and epileptiform abnormalities were seen on electro-encephalogram.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[109.1, 143.84, 274.98, 414.35], [113.01, 151.0, 357.01, 415.0], [107.0, 140.0, 231.0, 414.0]
【图像描述】：DWI (a, c, e) and ADC map (b, d, f) at the same levels as Figure 1 showing restricted diffusion in the hippocampi, cerebral cortex (note perirolandic sparing) and globi pallidi. T2 shine-through effect is seen in the putamina and caudate nuclei
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Hypoglycemic encephalopathy; Hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy; Creutzfeldt Jakob disease; Seizure related changes; Hepatic encephalopathy。结合特征，最终诊断为：Final Diagnosis not found.。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【A 22-year-old male with autism spectrum disorder and a history of eating disorders was presented to the emergency department due to abdominal pain, reduced communication, and refusal to eat or drink for 4 days. While he was hospitalised, he developed cognitive decline and his mental status changed.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[201.16, 229.11, 283.33, 268.07], [190.0, 212.0, 293.0, 277.0], [205.0, 235.0, 280.0, 265.0]
【图像描述】：Sagittal (2a) and axial (2b and 2c) FLAIR sequence indicating high signal at the tectal plate, posterior aspect of the brain stem, periaqueductal area, and mammillary bodies.
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Bi-thalamic and intraventricular haemorrhage with Wernicke’s encephalopathy; AVM; Deep cerebral venous thrombosis; Artery of Percheron infarct。结合特征，最终诊断为：Bi-thalamic and intraventricular haemorrhage with Wernicke’s encephalopathy。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【A malnourished 8-year-old girl with history of facial trauma 3 months prior, presented with somnolence, vomit and non-specific headache; a head CT was obtained (not shown), reporting a left frontal tumour. Lumbar puncture was performed and CSF analysis showed no abnormalities.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[275.99, 0.4, 467.98, 205.7], [282.0, 0.0, 478.0, 247.0], [267.0, 1.0, 453.0, 144.0]
【图像描述】：Follow up MRI showing axial FLAIR (A) and axial post-gadolinium T1(B) weighted images demonstrating increase in swelling and enhancement of subcutaneous tissue that extends to the nasal fossa and the left maxillary sinus. Dorsal axial FLAIR weighted image at orbitary level show preseptal soft tissue swelling (C) with marked enhancement in post-gadolinium T1 weighted image
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Granulomatous amebic encephalitis; High grade glioma; Lymphoma; Brain absscess。结合特征，最终诊断为：Granulomatous amebic encephalitis。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【An 18-year-old patient with neurofibromatosis type 1 was sent for MRI evaluation since a CT scan (not shown) revealed a large left frontal lesion.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[173.56, 65.3, 392.77, 274.33], [169.0, 64.0, 411.0, 288.0], [176.0, 66.0, 383.0, 267.0]
【图像描述】：Coronal T2-weighted image of the brain showing an irregular, heterogeneous, left frontal lesion with prominent vasogenic edema and marked mass effect causing subfalcine herniation
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Differential Diagnosis not found.。结合特征，最终诊断为：Intracranial malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【A 16-year-old male with no previous comorbidities came with complaints of occipital headache and vomiting since 2 months suggestive of intracranial hypertension. Central nervous system examination revealed evidence of papilledema without any cerebellar signs.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[187.81, 286.41, 305.18, 401.79], [185.0, 284.0, 312.0, 407.0], [192.0, 290.0, 295.0, 394.0]
【图像描述】：MR axial T1WI showing a well defined solid cystic lesion with solid component appearing hypointense and the cystic component appearing even more hypointense similar to CSF signal intensity.
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Differential Diagnosis not found.。结合特征，最终诊断为：Posterior fossa Rosette-forming glioneuronal tumour。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【The patient presented with sudden onset of seizures and loss of conscience.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[245.75, 323.22, 319.01, 399.69], [243.87, 343.21, 300.87, 399.21], [247.0, 310.0, 331.0, 400.0]
【图像描述】：No evidence of "blooming" to suggest calcification or hemosiderin.
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Cystic meningioma, type IV.; dural metastasis; primary intra-axial glial neoplasm。结合特征，最终诊断为：Cystic meningioma, type IV.。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【A 66-year-old female with type II diabetes mellitus since 25 years on irregular treatment, presenting with complaint of random, uncontrollable, involuntary, jerking movements of left upper limb and left lower-limb , her random blood sugar was found 580 mg/dl, HbA1c -17.46% and urine ketones ++.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[177.0, 177.59, 218.41, 269.0], [179.0, 182.0, 216.0, 271.0], [174.0, 171.0, 222.0, 266.0]
【图像描述】：MRI T2WI axial image show hypointense signal intensity involving right caudate nucleus and putamen.
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Diabetic striatopathy; Wilson’s disease; Manganese toxicity; Chronic hepatic encephalopathy; Striato-capsular infarct。结合特征，最终诊断为：Diabetic striatopathy。

作为神经影像AI助手，请结合患者病史：【A 12-year-old male presented with complaints of convulsion for the last year. He also had a history of developmental delay for the last 4 years. He was referred for MRI Brain study to rule out intracranial pathology.】，分析该脑部MRI影像。
请严格按照以下三个部分输出结果：
1. 异常定位：给出病灶的坐标边界框 [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]。
2. 图像描述：描述影像中的异常特征。
3. 诊断推理：给出鉴别诊断和最终的临床诊断。

【异常定位】：[177.0, 87.0, 264.0, 152.0], [177.0, 87.0, 264.0, 152.0]
【图像描述】：Diffusion Weighted image shows no evidence of restricted diffusion.
【诊断推理】：考虑鉴别诊断包括 Dysembryoplastic Neuroepithelial Tumor (DNET); Multinodular and vacuolating neuronal tumours; Low grade Glioma; Gangliogliomas。结合特征，最终诊断为：Dysembryoplastic Neuroepithelial Tumor (DNET)。
